sections.text: Verification & Badges
Built to create confidence on both sides of hiring
Why verification matters on HireHub
Verification brings clarity into hiring by making trust easy to recognise.
Confidence from the start
Employers gain early assurance when reviewing profiles, allowing conversations to start with clarity and purpose.
Fair candidate visibility
Candidates highlight their credibility through recognised signals that showcase preparation and commitment.
Focused screening
Clear verification indicators support efficient shortlisting by guiding attention to relevant profiles.
Instant trust signals
Badges communicate key information quickly, supporting decisions wherever profiles and CVs appear.
What gets verified on HireHub
Verified identity
Identity details are confirmed through a trusted verification partner, helping establish authenticity and credibility across profiles.
Time-stamped checks
Each verification includes a visible date and time, allowing employers to understand when checks were completed.
Visible verification status
Verification status remains clearly displayed on profiles and CVs, supporting confidence during search, matching, and review.
Clear verification badges
Badges communicate verification outcomes clearly, supporting informed decisions without unnecessary complexity.
Visible trust that moves hiring forward.

Verification badges turn important information into clear, recognisable signals. Each badge represents a specific achievement or confirmation, allowing employers and candidates to understand profile strength at a glance.
Badges create consistency across the platform, helping every interaction begin with shared clarity.
Badge types and what they represent
Identity Verified
Confirms that identity details have been successfully verified through a trusted process, supporting confidence during profile review and matching.
Training Completed
Shows completion of recognised training, highlighting commitment to skills, awareness, and preparedness for workplace expectations.
Profile Complete
Indicates a well-prepared profile with key information filled out, helping employers understand experience and preferences more easily.
Employer Rated
Reflects feedback shared by employers after completed work, adding practical insight and credibility over time.
Where badges appear across HireHub
Candidate profiles
Badges appear alongside personal and professional details, providing immediate context.
CVs
Badges travel with the CV, reinforcing credibility beyond the profile view.
Employer search results
Badges surface during candidate browsing, supporting faster shortlisting.
AI matching signals
Badges contribute to stronger matching relevance and visibility.
Stand out with recognised trust signals
How verification supports candidates
Higher search visibility
Verified profiles receive stronger visibility when employers browse or search for talent, helping the right roles appear sooner.
Stronger AI matching
Verification adds valuable context that enhances matching accuracy, aligning candidates with opportunities that suit their experience and goals.
Faster employer engagement
Clear trust signals encourage employers to begin conversations with confidence and intent.
Clear professional edge
Badges highlight preparation and commitment, helping candidates present themselves with clarity and confidence.
Added value through verification rewards
Recognition through rewards
Eligible verification journeys may include Amazon vouchers, adding extra value to the process.
Candidate-led choice
Verification remains available as an enhancement that candidates can select when ready.
Hire with confidence
Verification gives employers greater clarity from the very first interaction. When trust signals appear directly on profiles and CVs, hiring teams move forward with assurance and focus.
Benefits for employers
Access to verified candidates
Verification allows employers to highlight candidates who have completed trusted checks, supporting confident shortlisting.
Faster screening
Clear trust signals help teams spend time where it matters most, improving the pace of hiring.
Clear audit trail
Verification records include clear timestamps and status indicators, supporting accountability and clarity throughout the process.
Employer-led decisions
Hiring choices remain fully in the hands of employers, supported by transparent signals rather than automated outcomes.
Employer controls available
Role-based verification
Employers decide when verification is included as part of a job requirement.
Badges for prioritisation
Badges support prioritisation by highlighting candidate readiness during browsing and matching.
Flexible matching control
Verification works alongside AI matching or manual review, giving employers flexibility at every stage.
How verification supports AI matching
Verification builds credibility
Verified status adds trusted context to profiles, supporting stronger relevance during matching and search.
Complete profile alignment
AI considers skills, experience, preferences, location, and verified status to suggest aligned opportunities.
Employer control
Employers review matches with full visibility and remain in control of every hiring outcome.
Clear matching logic
Matching results reflect structured criteria that support understanding and confidence at every stage.
Training and badge features
Cyber security training
Candidates can complete recognised cyber security awareness training designed to support safe and responsible workplace behaviour.
Time-stamped badges
Training badges display clear completion dates and times, helping employers understand when learning took place.
Visible training signals
Training badges appear on profiles, CVs, and search results, supporting prioritisation during browsing and matching.
Ideal for security-focused roles
These badges carry particular value for roles involving data access, systems, or customer information.
How security and privacy are applied
Trusted verification partners
Verification is carried out through established partners that specialise in secure identity checks and responsible data practices.
Purpose-led data use
Information collected during verification supports clear outcomes and remains aligned with platform needs and regulatory expectations.
GDPR-aligned processes
Verification workflows follow UK and EU data protection principles, supporting transparency and accountability.
MFA-protected access
Account access is secured through multi-factor authentication, adding an extra layer of protection for users.
Clear audit trails
Verification actions include clear audit trails, supporting visibility and oversight across the platform.
